intent.proves: At least one account group (system account group type) exists with a customer number.
intent.scope: AccessUser rows of type 2 with AccessUserUserAndGroupType SystemAccount (value observed on a 10.29.x baseline database); complete enumeration

bindings.reason: get_user_groups lists every group; the account type and customer number need a field projection the mcp-count handler does not perform.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser WHERE AccessUserType = 2 AND AccessUserUserAndGroupType = 'SystemAccount' AND ISNULL(AccessUserCustomerNumber,'') <> ''
